proposition: Melvin-Koushki distinguishes lettrists from Hurufis and messianic Sufis by motive: Hurufis proclaim a new Persian dispensation, messianic Sufis promote themselves as political saviours, lettrists present themselves as occult philosophers working within the tradition; Ibn Turka's millenarianism, he says, insists on the binding finality of Muhammad's dispensation.

mediation.note: MK's own interpretation, offered in support of his thesis that Ibn Turka was an occult philosopher.
